chapter: Solo years, marriages and the Canadian party
title: Aftermath of the party and whether it was a setup
summary: They plan to punish Eddie Scarf for the tip-off, and Bubbles wonders if the party was a setup.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: So now we're going to whip this guy that's in the show because he's the one that told the fellas. So the next day we plan on getting him. I let Buck take care of him because Buck was for him. Eddie is the guy's name. Eddie is the guy that brought his wife in, Eddie Scarf, S-C-A-R-F.
Why were there no men left --
Don't ask me that, man. How would I know? They just wanted to have
a stag party for the women, that's all.
Why did they have Buck and Bubbles then?

Don't ask me -- that's the best of what they thought of Buck and Bubbles. Could have been a setup, who knows, 18 girls in negligees, it must have been a setup, man. Did you hear me tell Buck to don't dance with nobody? It must have been a setup, trying to get Buck and Bubbles in bad with the public. Plus they're an agency. Don't you understand. They couldn't take me no where they went, man, I was hip on all corners.
Why did you go to the party then?

I went to the party because I know what to do. That's why. I wind up all right. Nothin' happened to me. Listen, I cover the fence of the white woman, I cover the fence of all things. What did I do? I didn't grab none of the girls. I didn't humiliate none of the girls. Understand?
But it was one of the husbands that dropped you off.

Yeah, he knew what kind of a guy I was. Understand? He's only crying because I must be put up to a test or somethin', man. He would hate to see these two guys go down the drain. That's about what he's crying about. Understand? I hate to see these two guys, because they are good guys, man. He don't want to see us go down the drain. Understand? That's what he's crying about. But I don't know that. But when all the things crop up maybe I'll put two and two together. That's simple as pie. When a guy is gonna come down and tell all these girls, gonna get in and bust it, and know who's in there and everything, cuss them out. They were white. Why would he want to do it to hurt them.
